description: This is an abstract Java class that extends a Spring Batch RepositoryItemWriter for Loan entities, providing a mechanism to write Loan records and manage their locking state via a loanLockingService. It includes logic to delete locks for processed loans after writing.

classes.name: AbstractLoanItemWriter
classes.description: An abstract batch item writer for Loan entities that manages locking state, extending Spring Batch's RepositoryItemWriter.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Implements the batch writing logic; writes Loans and deletes associated locks after processing.

methods.name: getLockOwner
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the lock owner context.
